Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الْأَمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ
Translation: And spare us from lengthy hope, and shorten it for us with sincere action

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
Translation: So that we do not hope for the completion of one hour after another
Nor for the fulfillment of one day after another
Nor for the connection of one breath to another
Nor for the following of one step by another

Arabic text: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَ آمِنَّا مِنْ شُـرُورِهِ
Translation: Save us from its deception, and protect us from its evils
And place death firmly before our eyes
And do not make our remembrance of it occasional
And grant us from the righteous deeds
A deed with which we find slow our journey towards You

Arabic text: وَنَحْرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ
Translation: And through which we eagerly hasten to meet You

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأْنَسَنَا الَّذِيْ نَأْنَسُ بِهِ
Translation: Until death becomes our companion with which we feel comfortable

Arabic text: وَمَأْلَفَنَا الَّذِيْ نَشْتَاقُ إِلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِيْ نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
Translation: And our familiar place to which we long, and our special concern which we love to draw near to
So when You bring it upon us, and cause it to descend upon us

Arabic text: فَأَسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِرًا، وَ آنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِمًا
Translation: Make us happy with it as a visitor, and comfort us with it as one who arrives

Arabic text: وَلَا تُشْقِنَا بِضِيَافَتِهِ، وَلَا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيَارَتِهِ
Translation: And do not make us miserable by hosting it, nor disgrace us by its visitation
And make it a door from the doors of Your forgiveness
And a key from the keys of Your mercy
Cause us to die guided, not astray

Arabic text: طَائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ، تَائِبِينَ غَيْرَ عَاصِينَ وَلَا مُصِرِّينَ
Translation: Obedient, not reluctant; repentant, not disobedient nor persistent in sin
O Guarantor of the reward of the good-doers
And Reformer of the actions of the corrupters
